findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment:
The following canned foods were observed to have dents around the seams:

- Pineapple slices in pineapple juice (x4).
- Salmon in water fillet portions.
- Chunk light Tuna in oil (x2).
- Sweet sue chicken broth.
- Natural chunk chicken breast in water.

CORRECTED - Person-in-charge (PIC) was informed as well as educated on the potential contamination associated with dented cans, and the canned foods were voluntarily removed from the shelf. Ensure canned foods are in good condition to prevent exposure to potential contaminants that may lead to food borne illness. [PF]
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces were observed to have accumulation of dust in the walk-in cooler:
- The ceiling
- The fans and their casings
- The shelves
- The bottle rack on the shelves 

PIC was informed and he stated the areas mentioned above would be cleaned as soon as possible. Ensure non-food contact surfaces are cleaned regularly and kept free of dust accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: In the restroom, the handwashing sink was observed with trash inside, and the toilet, floor, and walls were visibly soiled and in need of cleaning. The PIC was informed and voluntarily removed the trash from the handwashing sink (CORRECTED). The PIC also stated that the restroom surfaces would be cleaned as soon as possible. Please ensure the restroom, including the sink, toilet, floors, and walls, is cleaned and maintained regularly.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.18 Cleaning of Plumbing Fixtures. PLUMBING FIXTURES such as HANDWASHING SINKS, toilets, and urinals shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. [C]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

The hands sink in the bathroom (the only sink in the facility) is without paper towels. The PIC was consulted and paper towels supplied during this inspection to correct. Ensure that paper towels are available at the hand sink at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x3)  6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

The following maintenance concerns need to be addressed: 1) Bathroom, remove popcorn ceiling and; 2) ceiling is stomped and show signs of water damage. Repair both prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

On arrival, there was not a CFPM present at the facility. The CFPM arrived during this inspection to correct the violation. Ensure that there are enough CFPMs to cover all shifts.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

An employee was observed to enter the kitchen, don gloves and begin food handling without washing hands. Education conducted to correct.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

There are two designated hand sinks in the facility. Of the the two, one is clogged and unusable and the other is blocked and unusable. This leads the inspector to the conclusion that hand washing has not been properly conducted prior to putting on the gloves observed by the kitchen worker during this inspection. Education has been conducted and the hand sink unblocked (line item 10) in the kitchen to allow for effective and timely hand washing.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.15: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands in a HANDWASHING SINK only. 

PIC indicated that because the hand sink in the bathroom is clogged/unusable, the employees have been using the mop sink in the bathroom for hand washing. An employee was also observed to wash hands in the three part sink. Hand washing should only take place in hand sinks. Education conducted.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

On arrival, neither hand sink in the facility has any hand drying items located with them. Paper towels were provided during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

The hand sink in the kitchen has multiple items stored in front of it blocking easy access. PIC was consulted and the items removed to correct.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. 

A can of tuna (approximately gallon size) is observed with several significant dents. PIC was consulted and the can removed during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

A personal cell phone is observed stored on the meat slicer in the kitchen. A conversation took place with the PIC in relation to maintaining th food contact items cleaned/sanitized and protected from contamination. The slicer was disassemble for cleaning to correct the violation.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-203.12: (A) Ambient air and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be accurate to +/- 1.5C. (B) accurate to +/- 3 Fahrenheit.  

The thermometer used in the display cooler holding cheese and cakes has its needle bottomed out on the gauge (-40+). Temperatures in the cooler are observed at 40F-41F. A new thermometer should be available and in the cooler prior to the follow up in two weeks.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor. 

Two bags of onions are stored on the floor in the back dry storage area. Items were moved during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels. 

A moist rag is observed on the pizza prep counter. PIC was consulted and indicated that a spray sanitizer was used along with the cloths for wiping the counters. This is a poor practice. Cloths should be store in a sanitizer solution of correct concentration between uses. If a spray bottle is used, paper towels should be used and discarded after each use. PC indicated that a bucket would be used moving forward. A bucket was made during this inspection to correct violation number 48 as well as this line item.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed. 

A soiled sifter is observes stored with clean utensils over the three part sink. PIC was consulted and the sifter moved during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

No sanitizer solution was available upon inspector’s arrival. CORRECTED Discussed with PIC and employee. Sanitizer solution was prepared. Sanitizer must be available during all times food is being handled/prepared.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair. 

The hand sink in the bathroom is currently clogged and inoperable. PIC is given two weeks to repair. Inspector will follow up at that time.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2)  6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

The following maintenance concerns need to be addressed: 1) Kitchen: cease use of tape on the light in the chicken hot holding; 2) Bathroom, remove popcorn ceiling; 3) ceiling is stomped and show signs of water damage. Repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

The shelves in the walk in cooler have significant dust and mold accumulation. PIC is instructed to clean often enough to maintain clean.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
Facility does not have signed reporting agreements on file. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC. Employees signed agreements during inspection. Keep signed reporting agreements on file for all employees.
2-103.11: (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD.  [Pf]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employee observed donning gloves upon entering the kitchen without washing hands first. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC & provided education. Wash hands before donning gloves to begin food prep.
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  [P]

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment:
Observed a pan of cooked ground beef in the lower portion of the prep cooler. PIC stated that it had been made yesterday and is typically prepared daily. Facility is not permitted to cool or reheat foods. CORRECTED— Facility will cease cooling foods. Ground beef was voluntarily discarded.
3-201.11: (A)-(B) FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source and not from private home. [P]

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
1st REPEAT: Eggs observed stored on the second shelf of the display cooler, over gallons of milk. Store eggs on the bottom shelf. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC. Cooler was rearranged.
3-307.11: FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301-3-306. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
1st REPEAT: Heavy frost accumulation observed in the kitchen upright freezer. Defrost freezer.
4-202.16: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. [C]

findings.comment: No sanitizer solution was available upon inspector’s arrival. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC and employee. Sanitizer solution was prepared. Sanitizer must be available during all times food is being handled/prepared.
